# Final Implementation Plan

## A. Finish commerce focus lifecycle
Read current surface/controller and pending focus helper. Rewrite the smallest whole-file surface integration. Add focused lifecycle tests. Run shared commerce + full platform regressions. Browser-prove focus return.

## B. Extend existing workflow continuity only where missing
Trace actual consumers of workspace launch descriptors and embed endpoints. If caller ergonomics are missing, add one reusable launch adapter and focused tests without weakening protocol validation.

## C. Product quality rails
Audit shared CSS/mobile behavior, game commerce semantics, and creator/developer paid capabilities. Implement only broad, fulfillment-backed improvements with whole-file rewrites.

## D. Performance truth
Re-check startup dependency graph. Make only explicit safe lazy-load changes; otherwise document measured debt behind legacy config/Auth/DosDB migration.

## E. Final proof
Regenerate derived assets, run all relevant tests, runtime-prove major user loops, inspect git overlap, reread touched files, and write planned-vs-actual plus remaining-work ledgers.
